_about: YouGov polls commissioned by The Australia Institute that do NOT channel into the auspol-tracker data model (no voting intention is published - the reports' own methodology statements record 'Is voting intention published? No'). Compiled by reading the Institute's published full-report PDFs; filed 2026-11-01 with the October 2026 'Friends and threats to Australia' brief. YouGov's own fortnightly News24 series is a separate house (news24-one-offs.json).
_readme: Verification: every figure was read from the published report PDF (Polling - Friends and threats to Australia, October 2026; cdn.australiainstitute.org.au .../Polling-Friends-and-threats-to-Australia-Web.pdf). The main table transposes the report's summary Table 1 (fact-checked column-wise against the country narratives, which put the United States first) so its rows read the answer options; rows reconcile to 100 within 0dp rounding, and every country column likewise sums to its summary-table row. The United States cuts are the report's appendix Tables 3, 4 and 5 verbatim (its gender and age columns are filed as separate by-gender / by-age tables per store convention); the report's ALP/COA/GRE/ON/IND/UND abbreviations are expanded to the site's group names. Each country beyond the United States also has gender/age/state/vote crosstabs in appendix Tables 2 and 6-16; those are not filed, so the one entry's cut tables stay the United States' own. Fieldwork 6-12 October 2026, n=1,100, online panel, Australian Polling Council compliant.

entries.question: A friendly country is one you view as safe and trustworthy. A threatening country is one you view with caution or suspicion. For each country below, do you view them as a friend or a threat to Australia?
entries.notes: The five countries were presented in a random order. Only 16% see the United States as a close friend (50% a friend or close friend against 42% a threat or major threat); New Zealand is a friend or close friend to 97% (77% close), Indonesia to 64%, China to 24% and Russia to 7%. By voting intention, One Nation voters are warmest on the US (36% close friend, 69% friend or close friend, 23% threat) and Greens voters the coldest (1% close friend, 70% threat). Commissioned by The Australia Institute; fieldwork and weighting by YouGov (YouGov Galaxy Pty Ltd), APC methodology statement linked from the report.
